text:
elaine: dropping a compact PRD & rollout checklist for "cross-service scoring". focusing on acceptance metrics, edge cases, and a clear canary + rollback plan. link: https://docs.google.com/draft

mohit: skimmedlooks solid. need clarity on how rerank weights interact when embedding model changes land.

elaine: suggestion: final_score = alpha * rerank_score + (1 - alpha) * sim_score. default alpha=0.7. canary should allow pinning embedding and rerank independently.

frank: agree on pinning. propose automated drift detector for embeddings (cosine distribution shift + AD test) and a comparator to surface rank flips.

sara: we need concrete gates. propose thresholds: nDCG@10 drop <= 1.5% vs baseline, avg positive-pair cosine drop <= 0.02, P95 latency <= 450ms (Dedicated) / <= 800ms (Hosted free), cost delta <= +20% during canary.

kevin: measure latency client-to-response (includes SDK). add KV cache pressure and memory OOM checks.

elaine: added. Edge cases in PRD: mismatch embedding dims -> fallback resize + event; empty query -> short-circuit to fallback ranking; duplicate docs -> dedupe pass; partial embedding failures -> degrade to rerank-only or lightweight fallback.

natalie: rollout plan?

elaine: proposed rollout:
- canary A: 0.5% internal prod traffic for 48h
- canary B: 2% beta customers (opt-in) for 7d
- staged: 10% -> 50% -> 100% daily increments if healthy

frank: rollback triggers: any gate violated on two consecutive 1h windows OR error rate increase > 0.5% absolute.

mohit: migration detail: dual-serving embeddings for 72h during version swaps so we can compare and re-index cached vectors. route via stable hash for deterministic comparison.

elaine: API contract tweak (optional params):
POST /v1/rerank
{
  "query": "...",
  "candidates": ["id1","id2"],
  "rerank_alpha": 0.7,
  "embedding_version": "v2.1"
}
Default: no pin -> use active embedding for customer routing.

sara: acceptance test plan: synthetic suite + 3 real customer slices (support FAQ, marketing, internal KB) with seeded ground truth. nightly regression + pre-rollout smoke.

elaine: observability hooks: per-request metadata (embedding_version, rerank_model, alpha), dashboards for nDCG/cosine/latency/cost, debug endpoint to fetch intermediate scores.

kevin: ops-bot, create runbook stub for rollback steps.

ops-bot: runbook created (stub): https://internal/runbooks/scoring-rollout. Steps: disable new rerank route, revert alpha, pin embedding to prior version, postmortem channel alert.

natalie: SDK gating: expose rerank_alpha and embedding_version in next minor SDK release; coordinate release windows.

frank: I'll add a small comparison harness and a smoke curl command for QA:
# smoke
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -d '{"query":"refund policy","candidates":["D1","D2","D3"]}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY"

mohit: I'll prototype the drift detector and link the repo: https://git.internal/embedding-drift-proto

elaine: next steps: @mohit to spec detector, @frank to build harness, @sara to finalize slices, @kevin to wire infra metrics. i'll update doc and request final review next Tue.
